summary.text: Marc Korman is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 16 who has served since January 14, 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Korman was House Majority Leader at the start of the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.

For 2025-2026 he chairs the Environment and Transportation Committee and is also listed on the Legislative Policy Committee, the Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
